subject: Supply chain attestation ask + SIG/CAIQ mapping
messages:
From: Arielle Morales <arielle.morales@lumenhealth.com>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@lumenhealth.com
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Subprocessor residency + SIG/CAIQ mapping request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — we liked how Redwood handles routing and fallback lanes. As part of our procurement review I need to validate a few items related to your third-party roster and controls mapping so we can close out the security questionnaire from our procurement team. Can you provide the following by EOD Friday (10/8)?

- A current subprocessor roster with country of processing and whether customers can opt for onshore-only processing (CSV ok).
- A short matrix mapping SIG/CAIQ questions we flagged to your SOC 2/other evidence (control IDs and a one-line note).
- Confirmation of KMS provider(s) for keys used in production and whether keys are customer-dedicated or multi-tenant.
- Any exceptions to data residency for logging/observability telemetry and the retention for audit logs.

If you already have a packaged bundle, a Drive link or HubSpot record is fine. We occasionally require an attestation letter for subprocessors that handle PHI — let me know if that applies.

Thanks,
Arielle
Arielle Morales
Senior Security Analyst, Lumen Health
[Attachment: questionnaire_highlights.pdf (PDF)]

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Arielle Morales <arielle.morales@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Subprocessor residency + SIG/CAIQ mapping request

Hi Arielle —

We can definitely get that to you. I'm looping in Marissa (compliance) and Ben (partner ops) to assemble the pack. Quick clarifications so we target exactly what you need:

- When you say "onshore-only" do you mean a contractual option we offer customers (reserved Dedicated / Private SKU) or a per-account configuration we can enable today?
- For the SIG/CAIQ mapping: do you want the full questionnaire with our annotated answers or just the subset of controls you flagged?

We'll aim to deliver: annotated SIG sheet, current subprocessor roster with residency column, SOC 2 summary, and a short attestation note for PHI-handling subprocessors if applicable. If we can confirm scope tomorrow morning we should be able to hit your Friday deadline.

Best,
Soojin
Soojin Lee
Head of Trust & Compliance, Redwood Inference
[Redwood Inference | redwood.ai]

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 Oct 2027 09:21:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Subprocessor residency + SIG/CAIQ mapping request

Thanks Soojin — quick update on items I pulled together:

1) Subprocessor roster: attached CSV is v3 (columns: provider, role, country, processes_ph, onshore_option). Note: two infra partners (NimbusOps, EdgeScale) have mixed-region footprints; for customers on Dedicated/Private we can sign territorial commitments via the contract annex (we do not enable per-request tenancy switches for Hosted accounts).

2) SOC 2: attached is a one-page summary (redwood_soc2-summary.pdf) plus the auditor report reference and snapshot date.

3) SIG/CAIQ mapping: I started an annotated sheet for the controls Arielle flagged and marked ones that are covered by the SOC 2 and those requiring supplemental evidence (see column "evidence_note"). There are three items where we need Ben's input:
   - CAIQ SC-13 (transport-layer cert rotation cadence) — confirm who rotates observability certs for EdgeScale.
   - SIG 3.4 (subprocessor vetting) — need the latest attestation letter for CryptoVault (third-party HSM provider).
   - CAIQ ID-6 (customer key separation) — verify KMS tenancy details for Dedicated customers.

Attachments: subprocessor_roster_v3.csv, redwood_soc2-summary.pdf, sig-lite-answers-annotated.xlsx

Marissa
Director, Compliance Operations

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Arielle Morales <arielle.morales@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Oct 2027 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Subprocessor residency + SIG/CAIQ mapping request

Arielle / team — attaching the roster and annotated SIG sheet we just completed. Short answers inline for the flagged items:

- Transport certs (CAIQ SC-13): EdgeScale rotates observability TLS certs on a 90-day cadence; NimbusOps manages certs via Let's Encrypt for their gateway, and we have documented rotation logs for last 12 months (we can provide a CSV snippet if you want).

- CryptoVault attestation (SIG 3.4): CryptoVault provided an HSM attestation letter; attached excerpt in the Drive link. For PHI-handling subprocessors, we provide an addendum attestation and can sign a subprocessor appendix for Dedicated/Private customers.

- Customer key separation (CAIQ ID-6): For Dedicated/Private we can offer customer-dedicated KMS keys (Azure Key Vault or AWS KMS) with customer-managed key options. Hosted customers use multi-tenant keys with strict logical separation and KM telemetry; we note this in the "evidence_note" column.

Next steps: Arielle, please confirm whether Lumen needs the full SIG dump or the annotated subset. If full, we'll push the complete SIG bundle to the shared Drive and a HubSpot ticket for tracking.

Thanks — attaching the Drive link and a short CSV excerpt for cert rotation logs.

Ben Carter
Partner Operations, Redwood Inference
[Attachments/Drive links]
[Attachment: cert_rotation_12mo_snippet.csv (CSV)]
